n51_blocker_root_cause: MISDIAGNOSIS in `docs/strategic_alm_tension_field_exec_E_results_2026_05_01.md` §1: claim is `absence of general hxc hexa->native compiler on Mac/ubu1/ubu2 (only single-program AOT shards hxc_a25..a34 exist)`. Reality: `hexa build <src> -o <out>` works on Mac when two policy gates are honored.

actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.name: Darwin /tmp panic-trigger output-path refusal
actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.rule_summary: On Darwin, `hexa build` refuses output paths matching: (a) basename ends `_mac` / `-mac` / `_darwin`, (b) output under `/tmp` or `/private/tmp`, (c) source has `@refuse` / `@heavy` annotation
actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.rationale: 2026-04-20 03:33 Mac kernel panic (train_alm_lora_mac swap exhaustion, 49 swapfiles, loginwindow watchdog 91s)
actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.bypass: HEXA_MAC_BUILD_OK=1 env var (CI dry-run, non-heavy only)
actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.n51_impact: N-51 EXEC E wrote outputs to /tmp/n51_E/* — exactly the refused path. Bypass + non-/tmp output dir resolves immediately.
actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.feasibility_in_session: ZERO upstream change needed; N-51 caller fix is one-line env export + change output dir.

actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.name: auto-invoke conflict on `fn main()` + top-level `main()` call
actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.rule_summary: If a script defines `fn main()` AND has a top-level `main()` call, transpile errors with `auto-invoke conflict — fn main() is auto-called by hexa-strict AND a top-level main() call was found`
fix_options: Strip the trailing `main()` line (auto-invoke handles it)
Add `@manual_main` attribute on `fn main` to opt out of auto-invoke
actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.n51_impact: All three N-51 components (comp1, comp3, comp4) had `fn main(){...} \n main()` — both pattern. Stripping last line resolves all three.
actual_gates_blocking_n51_comp_1_3_4.feasibility_in_session: ZERO upstream change needed; N-51 caller fix is one-line `awk` strip per file.
